summary: All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile with no new layout breakage. Performance on the two project detail pages remains below the 85 threshold (83 and 82 respectively), though both show meaningful improvement from the previous audit; the home page TBT dropped sharply from 237 ms to 93 ms, a welcome recovery.

pages.visual_fingerprint: Dark full-page portfolio home with a hero 'App Design' section showing device mockups, followed by alternating sections for skills, a vertical timeline, case studies, technologies, conferences, and a contact form at the bottom.

visual_findings: On mobile, a large blank area persists between the intro text and the Engineering Culture sub-section, consistent with prior audits — likely a tall decorative or animated element that does not render visibly on mobile.
pages.visual_fingerprint: About page with dark theme, 'About Me' heading, inline code-block bio panel, stat counters (12+, 16+, 2, 7), Engineering Culture section, and a contact form footer; mobile shows an extended blank gap in the hero area.

Projects index with dark header, AI-powered 'Keep these projects alive' funding banner, three featured project cards (Token Field, Noise Translator, Tail Risk Lab) with canvas/waveform visuals, followed by a 3-column 'All Projects' grid and a contact form footer.

Clinical Note Structurer demo page with breadcrumb nav, 'Evals: 10/10 passing' badge, PHI disclaimer banner, two-column visit-note/structured-result panel, action buttons, collapsible JSON and architecture sections, and a contact footer.

Screenshot → PrimeVue demo page with drag-and-drop upload zone, three sample screenshot thumbnails (Login form, Analytics dashboard, Pricing page), empty mapping output area, collapsible 'View raw JSON' and 'How this works' sections, and a contact footer.

top_fix: The two project detail pages (/projects/note-structurer at 83, /projects/screenshot-to-primevue at 82) remain persistently below the 85 performance threshold with LCPs above 4 s — investigate deferred loading of demo-page JS (canvas/AI worker initialisation) and lazy-load below-the-fold assets to push both pages above 85.
